info.name: CrownEx API
info.description:
# CrownEx API

Complete Postman documentation for the CrownEx backend (Django REST Framework) covering the mobile app-facing API and the Admin Panel API.

## Base URL
All requests use the `{{base_url}}` variable from the active environment. Point it at your local server (`http://127.0.0.1:8000`) or your deployed Railway URL.

## Authentication
- **User endpoints** use JWT bearer auth (`Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`). Run **Auth → Login** (or the registration pipeline) first — the access/refresh tokens are captured into the environment automatically via a test script.
- **Admin endpoints** (`/api/admin/...`) use a *separate* JWT pair issued by **Admin – Auth → Admin Login**, stored as `admin_access_token`/`admin_refresh_token` so you can hold a user session and an admin session at the same time. Admin endpoints require `is_staff=True`.
- Access tokens expire after 60 minutes; refresh tokens after 7 days. Use the **Refresh Token** request when a call starts returning 401.
- A few endpoints are intentionally public: `GET /api/crypto/prices/`, `GET /api/crypto/fees/`, and the three webhook receivers (Flutterwave, PluginNG, Reloadly, Quidax) which authenticate via a shared secret/signature instead of a user session.

## Transaction PIN
Most money-moving endpoints (VTU purchases, gift card buys, crypto orders/withdrawals, virtual card actions) require the 4-digit transaction PIN set via **Auth → Set Transaction PIN**, sent as `pin` or `transaction_pin` depending on the endpoint.

## Error shape
Business-logic errors (raised as a `*ServiceError` on the backend) come back as:
```json
{ "detail": "Human-readable message", "code": "machine_readable_code" }
```
Validation errors from DRF serializers come back as `{ "field_name": ["message"] }` with status 400.

## Folder map
- **Auth / Profile** — signup pipeline, login, password/PIN management
- **Wallet (NGN)** — Flutterwave-backed deposits/withdrawals
- **VTU** — airtime, data, cable TV, electricity (PluginNG)
- **Gift Cards** — Reloadly-backed digital gift cards
- **Crypto** — buy/sell/swap, deposits, withdrawals (Quidax)
- **KYC** — identity verification (Dojah)
- **Virtual Cards** — USD card issuing (Bitnob)
- **Admin – \*** — the staff-only back office used by the CrownEx admin panel (crownex-admin)

item.name: Auth

request.description: Step 1 of signup. Creates an unverified user and emails a 4-digit OTP. Console email backend prints the OTP to the Django server log in dev.
Step 2 of signup. Verifies the registration OTP sent by /register/. Alias: /verify-email/ (identical view).
Resends the registration OTP (60s cooldown). Alias: /resend-verification/ (identical view).
Step 3 of signup, after email verification. Sets name + password and returns JWT access/refresh tokens plus the user object.
Authenticated. Sets the 4-digit transaction PIN required by most money-moving endpoints (wallet withdraw, VTU purchases, crypto orders, cards, gift cards).
Email + password login. Returns JWT access/refresh tokens plus the user object. Automatically saves access_token/refresh_token to the environment.
SimpleJWT TokenRefreshView. Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token. ROTATE_REFRESH_TOKENS is on, so a new refresh token is also returned and should replace the stored one.
Blacklists the given refresh token server-side.
Always returns 200 with a generic message regardless of whether the email exists, to avoid account enumeration.
Validates the OTP sent by forgot-password before letting the UI show the "new password" screen.

item.description: Registration pipeline, session (login/logout/refresh), password/PIN changes, and password reset. All endpoints are under /api/auth/ except refresh (SimpleJWT).

item.name: Profile

request.description: Partial update — send only the fields you want to change: full_name, phone, profile_picture. For a profile picture upload use multipart/form-data with a `profile_picture` file field instead of this raw-JSON body.

item.description: GET/PUT/PATCH the logged-in user's own profile. Not under /api/auth/ — mounted directly at /api/profile/.

item.name: Wallet (NGN)

request.description: Creates a pending deposit transaction and returns the Flutterwave public key + customer payload needed to launch Flutterwave checkout client-side. Save tx_ref for the verify-payment call.
Called after the Flutterwave checkout flow completes client-side; re-verifies with Flutterwave server-side and credits the wallet.
Not called by the app — this is what Flutterwave calls on your server. Included here for testing/replaying webhook payloads. Requires the Verif-Hash header to match FLW_WEBHOOK_HASH.

Requires transaction_pin support was folded into WithdrawSerializer? No — check response codes; PIN is NOT required by this serializer (only amount/account fields). Processed within 24 hours per response message.
Latest 50 wallet transactions for the current user.

item.description: NGN wallet: balance, Flutterwave-backed deposits, bank withdrawals, bank lookup, and transaction history.

item.name: VTU (Airtime, Data, Cable, Electricity)

request.description: Airtime networks, and data networks with their plans (PluginNG-backed).
Looks up the customer name for a smartcard number before purchase confirmation.
Note: variation_code reuses the Prepaid/Postpaid choice field (matches backend serializer as written).
Re-queries PluginNG for the current status of a pending purchase. Set vtu_reference in the environment or edit the URL path.
Latest 50 VTU transactions (airtime/data/cable/electricity) for the current user.
Not called by the app — PluginNG calls this on your server. The secret is a path segment, not a header, and must match PLUGINNG_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

item.description: Airtime, data, cable TV, and electricity purchases via PluginNG, plus transaction status/history.

item.name: Gift Cards

request.description: Current app-controlled NGN-per-USD rate used to price gift cards.
Latest 50 gift card purchases for the current user.
Not called by the app — Reloadly calls this on your server. The secret is a path segment and must match RELOADLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

item.description: Digital gift card purchases (Apple, Amazon, Google Play, etc.) via Reloadly.

item.name: Crypto

request.description: Public — no auth required. Live NGN prices for supported coins.
Public — display-only fee config for client-side estimates. The real fee is frozen onto the quote at quote time.
The user's internal crypto balances — source of truth, not Quidax's raw balances.
Locks rate + fee for 30 seconds. type is buy|sell|swap; to_coin is required only for swap. Save the returned id as crypto_quote_id to place an order.
Latest 50 buy/sell/swap orders for the current user.

Uses a quote from POST /quote/. If needs_payment is true in the response, the client still owes money via Flutterwave or bank transfer before crypto is delivered; wallet-funded orders complete synchronously.
Called after Flutterwave checkout completes client-side for a buy order.
For bank-transfer buys only. Doesn't execute the order — an admin reviews and approves via POST /api/admin/crypto/orders/<reference>/.

formdata.description: Image file (screenshot/photo) of the bank transfer receipt.

request.description: Sells immediately if balance is sufficient; otherwise comes back waiting_deposit — retry via the retry endpoint once funded.
Requires the full source-coin balance up front; fails immediately (no waiting_deposit fallback) if insufficient. Quote must have been created with type=swap and a to_coin.

query.description: Required for multi-network coins like USDT.

request.description: Provisions a Quidax sub-account on first use if the user doesn’t have one yet. Set crypto_coin (e.g. btc, usdt) in the environment or edit the URL path.
Best-effort Quidax sub-account warm-up; call fire-and-forget when the user opens the crypto section. Always answers 200.
No side effects — fee/net-amount preview before confirming a withdrawal.
No admin approval needed — address format, min notional, daily NGN cap, and balance reservation guard this. network is required for multi-network coins.
Latest 50 crypto withdrawals for the current user.

Not called by the app — Quidax calls this on your server. Verified via the quidax-signature header, format t=<timestamp>,s=<hex HMAC-SHA256(QUIDAX_WEBHOOK_SECRET, "<timestamp>.<raw_body>")>; you cannot produce a valid signature from Postman without computing it yourself. Handled events: deposit.successful, wallet.address.generated, order.done/order.completed, withdraw.successful, withdraw.rejected.

item.description: Crypto trading (buy/sell/swap), deposits, withdrawals via Quidax. Prices and public fees are unauthenticated; everything else requires login.

item.name: KYC (Identity Verification)

request.description: Multipart. Calls Dojah synchronously; approved/rejected are final for the auto-decided score range, review sits in the admin queue. Sandbox test NIN: 70123456789.
Returns { "status": null } if the user has never submitted a verification.

item.description: Identity verification via Dojah (NIN/BVN + selfie liveness match) — required before requesting a virtual card.

item.name: Virtual Cards

request.description: KYC- and PIN-gated. Creates the card in Bitnob asynchronously (status starts pending) — poll GET /status/ for the final state.
Returns { "status": null } if no card exists yet. Refreshes from Bitnob if still pending/processing.
Debits the NGN wallet and credits the USD virtual card balance.
Debits the USD card balance and credits the NGN wallet.
Latest 50 transactions for the current user’s card.

item.description: USD virtual card issuing and management via Bitnob (request, fund, withdraw, freeze/unfreeze, terminate).

item.name: Admin Panel
Admin – Auth

request.description: One-time bootstrap for the first admin/staff account. Gated by the X-Admin-Secret header, which must match ADMIN_REGISTRATION_SECRET in the backend environment (returns 503 if that env var is unset). Not needed for day-to-day admin login — only for creating new admin accounts.
Staff accounts only (is_staff=True) — 403 for a regular user account. Returns JWT access/refresh tokens; automatically saved to admin_access_token/admin_refresh_token.

item.description: Bootstrap the first admin account, then log in. All other admin endpoints require the resulting admin_access_token (IsAdminUser).

item.name: Admin – Dashboard

request.description: Dashboard stat cards (totals across users, transactions, etc.).
Provide new_email and/or full_name; current_password is always required to confirm the change.

item.description: Admin dashboard overview stats and the logged-in admin’s own account.

item.name: Admin – Users

request.description: Set admin_target_user_id in the environment, or edit the URL path directly.

item.description: Read-only user directory and detail view for support/ops.

item.name: Admin – Transactions

query.description: all | deposit | withdrawal | airtime | data | cable | electricity | vtu | giftcard

item.description: Cross-service transaction feed (wallet deposits/withdrawals, VTU, gift cards) for ops visibility.

item.name: Admin – Crypto Fees

request.description: Auto-creates buy/sell/swap/withdraw fee rows on first call if missing.
Only affects quotes created after this save — quotes already locked keep their frozen fee. Set admin_fee_id from the List Fee Settings response.

item.description: Configure buy/sell/swap/withdraw fee percentages and flat USD fees for crypto trading.

item.name: Admin – Crypto Orders

request.description: action: approve (bank-transfer buy with proof → execute) | reject (cancel stuck pending_payment/waiting_deposit) | confirm_deposit (waiting_deposit sell → re-attempt, e.g. missed webhook) | retry (re-attempt a failed buy).

item.description: Review and act on bank-transfer buys awaiting proof approval, stuck orders, and missed-webhook recovery.

item.name: Admin – Crypto Withdrawals

request.description: action: complete (requires tx_id) | reject. Manual recovery for when a withdraw.successful/withdraw.rejected webhook never arrived.

item.description: Manual recovery path for crypto withdrawals when Quidax’s webhook never arrives.

item.name: Admin – KYC

request.description: action: approve | reject. Manual override for verifications sitting in `review` (Dojah match score 70–89) or to correct an auto-decided outcome.

item.description: Manual review queue for identity verifications in the gray-zone score range or needing correction.

item.name: Admin – Virtual Cards

query.description: Matches masked PAN or user email

request.description: Read-only. Cards move through Bitnob’s own lifecycle automatically — no manual approve/reject step like KYC or crypto orders. For visibility and manual recovery only.

item.description: Read-only visibility into all issued virtual cards.
Staff-only back office API consumed by the crownex-admin React dashboard. Requires an admin JWT (see Admin – Auth) with is_staff=True.
